dynamic_start_contract.interpretation: This checks whether release-time dynamic sensor observations match the real start row. The first_dynamic_update fields report immediate post-release drift and are not used for the start-state pass/fail gate.

interpretation.estimator_surface_warning: real /mavros/local_position/* is an FC estimator output; plant replay publishes a MuJoCo truth-like compatibility surface. Treat direct Bar30/IMU/DVL metrics as the primary sensor contract.

reasons: rc_out_ch* came from real /mavros/rc/out, which is SERVO_OUTPUT_RAW telemetry
not allowed for HAN/CFD/fluid/thrust target export before contract reconstruction

plant_input_observability_contract.interpretation: This is an observability gate, not a physics fit. If it fails, hydrodynamic/thrust tuning against high-rate sensor correlation is not a valid next step because actuator history between telemetry steps is unobserved.
reasons: plant input source is output telemetry: real_mavros_rcout_servo_output_raw_telemetry
plant input semantic layer is not exportable: real_controller_output_telemetry
input PWM step rate is below real DVL update rate
input PWM step rate is below real IMU update rate

sensor_corr_readiness_contract.interpretation: This gate enforces contract-first work. HAN/CFD/fluid/thrust tuning is blocked until direct dynamic sensor correlations are at least the requested gate.

sensor_input_phase_contract.interpretation: Offsets are measured from the most recent replayed PWM step to each sensor update. This separates phase/timing contract errors from hydrodynamic or thrust coefficient errors.

sensor_rate_contract.interpretation: Rates are effective observation update rates inside the audit window, not raw CSV row rates. Real rows are inferred from value changes; sim rows use probe sequence counters when available.

thruster_input_contract.interpretation: This reports both strict sample-time equality and step delivery latency from probe input_rcout_ch1..8 to thruster_debug sitl_ch1..8_pwm. For high-rate inputs that change faster than thruster_debug sampling, all-step delivery is not observable; use sampled_runtime_contract for the active replay-window backend check.

sampled_runtime_contract.interpretation: Compares active thruster_debug sitl_ch*_pwm samples against the plant input CSV at the corresponding source time. This is the right diagnostic when plant input changes faster than the thruster_debug sample rate, so not every input step can be observed as a separate debug row.
